summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'), so POST /orders and the ledger sync fail. The cause of the read-only state is unknown. It is likely a storage or permission problem outside the service.
recommended: A human should restore write access to the database (check the file or volume permissions, disk-full or read-only remount, and the DB host).
After that, run check_invariants and confirm the ledger sync resumes.
Don't roll back or restart the worker: neither addresses a read-only DB, and v1.3 doesn't match the timing.
